name: Critical Sensor Monitoring
description: Monitors temperature and vibration sensors to detect potential equipment failures requiring immediate maintenance attention.
notificationText: MAINTENANCE REQUIRED: Critical sensor thresholds exceeded. TECHNICIAN INSTRUCTIONS: 1) Check temperature sensor readings - if above 80°C, inspect cooling system and replace filters if necessary. 2) Check vibration levels - if above 5.0 units, inspect motor bearings and belt tension. 3) Document all findings in maintenance log. 4) Contact supervisor if readings remain critical after initial checks. Safety: Ensure equipment is in safe mode before inspection.
